answer: Score each identity by how many node-disjoint paid paths it can keep to a rotating seed committee, counting only paths that share no relay with any other claimant. Extra keypairs are cheap to forge, but extra independent routes are not: a clone farm collapses into one raven wearing many bands once reused hosts, transit providers, and payment rails leave the same pigment on every path. Merged identities share a single reward slot, so an attacker must buy distinct connectivity and counterparties for each fake they want to keep earning.
